item.description:
Clearer results and more useful email evidence

  • Email addresses, sender details and links now stay intact by default. Only likely credit-card numbers are redacted. Optional email redaction is available in Advanced filtering settings; custom rules keep your choices.
  • Accessibility reads wider and deeper app trees, with more time for manual checks and clearer diagnostics when a read is partial.
  • Local sender checks recognize service-role names such as “X-Request” alongside a matching account-alert subject and an unrelated sender domain.
  • Incomplete link checks appear as a small coverage note. Unimplemented AI-image detection is no longer listed as a missing check. Strong local warnings still take priority over a high server score.
  • Company and sender checks now cover billing, refunds and forwarded messages, using the server’s full shared company directory and offline lookalike-domain rules.
  • Findings name the company, sender and destination, with concrete next steps and compact link-failure details.
  • Passive checks prioritize exposed document content and can supplement thin Accessibility reads with local OCR. Unfamiliar domains alone stay quiet at Balanced sensitivity.

Physical Superhuman coverage still varies with the content it exposes. This update does not change the server's link fetching or numeric scoring.
